turns.assessment: The reported degradation is not corroborated by any in-scope observation. Receiver power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD and SOP metrics remained unchanged on all three lightpaths carrying V1, while numerous services sharing those optical paths remained healthy. This strongly argues against a line-system, ROADM, amplifier or fibre cause; the evidence is insufficient to isolate a service-specific endpoint or ODU fault.

proposals.rationale: A service-specific endpoint fault could affect V1 without disturbing shared optical channels. However, the documented mode is a hard client-down failure, whereas only uncorroborated degradation is reported.
Degradation at the S20-side receiver could reduce quality in one direction while leaving other channels unaffected, but its receiver power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD and SOP rate all showed no change.
A receiver-local problem at the S17 endpoint could affect the reverse direction, but all monitored receiver-quality indicators remained unchanged.
Margin erosion can present as degraded channel quality, but it should be reported at a line receiver; none of the receivers on V1's lightpaths recorded a corresponding change.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
